podcast.body: The title track from their 1981 album, "Vienna," became a huge hit in the UK and Europe and prominently features the modified Roland CR-78 drum machine, showcasing its unique sonic contributions. "We can hear that work in Vienna, the title track of Ultravox's 1981 album, and a huge hit in the UK and Europe."
